regions.finding: Sixteen scope rows were checked row by row. Entry 1 is merged with Table 1 entry 3; entries 2-15 remain separate substrate-scope experiments; entry 8 includes the 10 mol% PtCl4 and 2 equiv allenol override; entry 16 preserves 100% recovery of 1h and decomposition of 2a rather than inventing a zero yield.

A distinct no-reaction control between indole 1a and dihydropyran 4aa under 5 mol% PtCl4 in THF was extracted with 100% recovery of 1a and 77% recovery of 4aa. Duration and temperature are not printed.

The preparation of 2a-D was separated into Jones oxidation (56%), LiAlD4 reduction in Et2O at -40 °C (84%), and an ortho-Claisen/LiAlH4 two-step sequence (140 °C then THF/room temperature, 59% over two steps). The undrawn Claisen intermediate was not invented.

The N-methylindole/2a-D cyclization was extracted as a separate isotope experiment: 5 mol% PtCl4, THF, room temperature, 56% product, with 28% D at C3-prime and 25% D at C1-double-prime. The main text defers the determination method to unavailable SI.
The multi-arrow network through intermediates 5-13 is explicitly a proposed mechanistic rationale and is classified as mechanism, not as independently isolated experiments.
